lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four to five roughly horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the lateral flank. The spots transition from dense, smaller clusters near the gills to larger, more isolated nodes in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the posterior half of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three distinct, elongated high-luminance features (likely remoras or ectoparasites) are attached to and trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
